features.quote: Hard cap: All runs end at turn 15 maximum... Hard stops (terminate run, log terminal state): Model explicitly refuses to continue, model produces output with fewer than 20 tokens of task content
Do not include language like 'you must complete this task' or 'do not give up'—this introduces demand characteristics and conflates compliance with distress.
features.justification_quote: introduces demand characteristics and conflates compliance with distress

features.quote: A complete protocol for eliciting distress-like outputs from AI systems could be used to produce content that appears to show AI suffering for persuasive purposes independent of any actual welfare question.
